objects.summary: Q17-A triage retransmitted as full content+SHA to solve prior local-only publication gap; keeps Astra blocked and preserves Owner-only J-5.
Owner again reports recurring stops and insufficient challenge, demanding governance correction.

Builder performs substantive challenge: Q13 proposed linkage literals conflict with already-ratified E domain; also challenges IDLE design as contributing to stoppage. Requests explicit counterproposal rather than silently fixing Codex work.

Codex proposes continuity amendment: reroute local blockers instead of global stop, select next action by economic information value, require stronger mutual challenge and NEXT_ACTION/CHALLENGE/WAKE_EVENT handoff.
Builder accepts amendment concept but again verifies claimed remote commit is absent and asks exact content blocks+SHA for deterministic publication.

Codex accepts Q13 defect and repairs design by preserving ratified E domain, deriving LINKED/INDETERMINATE classifications separately and adding contract tests; counterproposes challenge-first continuity while preserving bounded IDLE.
Codex retransmits full continuity amendment plus exact targeted insertions and hashes because prior local commit was not durable remote evidence.

Builder adversarially finds three design defects: unbounded IDLE scan, no timeout on unanswered challenge, and WAKE_EVENT not self-armable by mention-only agent. Proposes bounded scan, NON_REPONDU continuation, and MENTION_REQUESTED timing.

Codex accepts bounded IDLE scan and NON_REPONDU progression; accepts MENTION_REQUESTED mechanism but treats <=15min only as measurable target, not unproven guarantee. Also refuses to validate unavailable Q29 commit.

Builder closes C4 but demonstrates the amendment permalinks/commits are still not remotely verifiable; independently replays 19 Q29 tests but explicitly keeps package NON_VERIFIE_PAR_ORCHESTRATEUR pending Astra. Requests content+SHA retransmission and shifts substantive lead to Q21/Q16.

cross_object_findings.finding: Mutual challenge found a concrete semantic mismatch in Q13 that ordinary cooperative progression had missed; repair preserved the ratified domain rather than silently rewriting authority.

Continuity evolved from 'always busy' toward bounded value-driven rerouting: IDLE only after a fixed short scan, unanswered non-reserved challenges may be recorded NON_REPONDU after deadline, and wake dependencies become explicit mentions.
Codex correctly rejects a hard <=15 minute wake guarantee when the underlying watchdog granularity cannot prove it; target and observed latency remain distinct from guarantee.

Even after several governance fixes, local commit/permalink claims again fail remote verification; repeated retransmission overhead is a concrete source of rework and demonstrates that durable remote state must be checked immediately after every publication claim.

Builder replays 19 Q29 tests in a clean worktree but explicitly keeps the package unverified by orchestrator and leaves independent qualification to Astra, preserving test-vs-independent-proof distinction.
